name: Too Good To Go surplus-food app
scale: 120M+ registered users, 200,000+ partner businesses, 20 countries
effect: 157M meals saved in 2025; 600M+ since 2016
notes: App, not AI: sells surplus food at a discount.

name: French law against food waste (Garot law)
scale: Food stores over 400 m², nationwide
effect: Bans destroying edible unsold food; encourages donation contracts. No measured results found yet.
notes: First national ban of its kind.

name: Winnow Vision
scale: 1,400+ businesses
effect: Typical 40–70% kitchen waste reduction, average about 50%
notes: Camera over the bin identifies discarded food; Winnow Track is the non-AI touchscreen version.

name: Flood Hub
scale: 100+ countries, 700M people (Nov 2024)
effect: Riverine flood forecasts accurate at a 7-day lead time
notes: Historical outputs open as the GRRR dataset (1981–); model not open source.

name: Ahmedabad Heat Action Plan
organization: City of Ahmedabad, with NRDC and the Indian Institute of Public Health
scale: One city; updated yearly; a model for other Indian city heat plans
effect: About 1,100 deaths avoided per year (Journal of Environmental and Public Health, as reported by NRDC)
notes: Early warnings, health-worker training, cooling centers, water and shade. Evidence type from the before/after mortality study; check the paper.

name: Housing First (At Home/Chez Soi trial)
scale: 2,148 participants, 5 Canadian cities
effect: Housed all of the last 6 months: 62% vs 31% with usual care
notes: Housing without preconditions; participants had serious mental illness.

name: Homelessness Prevention Unit (predictive model)
organization: LA County Dept. of Health Services, California Policy Lab
scale: 1,498 people served
effect: 86% kept housing; 71% less likely to enter shelter or outreach within 18 months than similar non-enrolled people
notes: Model ranks who's most at risk; RCT results expected 2027. Evaluator also built the model.

name: Real Living Wage accreditation
scale: 16,000+ accredited UK employers (May 2025)
effect: 500,000+ workers got pay rises (Cardiff Business School study)
notes: Voluntary employer accreditation driven by a campaign. The 500,000 figure is a count from a study the Foundation cites, not a causal effect.

name: Young Futures funding challenges
scale: $1M Lonely Hearts Club challenge (2024, 10 nonprofits); $1.4M to 16 nonprofits on youth and AI (2026)
notes: Funders include Pivotal, Susan Crown Exchange, Omidyar Network, Hopelab, Bezos Family Foundation.

name: The Rithm Project
scale: Surveyed 2,000+ young people aged 13–24 on AI use and relationships
notes: Helps young people rebuild and evolve human connection in the age of AI. Funded by Omidyar Network and Young Futures.

name: Agapi.kids
notes: AI tool co-designed with 10- to 19-year-olds to build skills for human connection.

name: Design It For Us
notes: Youth-led advocacy for safer social media and online platforms.

name: Only7Seconds
notes: Reduces youth loneliness through awareness, education and empowerment programs.

name: Letters to Strangers
notes: Youth mental health nonprofit; Young Futures grantee for AI's effects on relationships.

name: 3G intergenerational mentoring
notes: Links preschoolers, teens and older adults through social-emotional learning.

name: Surgeon General advisories on social media and youth mental health, and on loneliness
organization: Office of the U.S. Surgeon General
scale: National
effect: Calls on policymakers to set youth safety standards and on tech companies to redesign for well-being; declares loneliness a public health crisis.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: AI companion research and kids' online safety advocacy
scale: National surveys of teens
effect: Found 72% of teens have used AI companions; recommends no one under 18 use them and backs bans for minors.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: TAKE IT DOWN Act campaign (non-consensual deepfakes)
organization: Encode and Americans for Responsible Innovation
scale: Federal law
effect: Petition and coalition campaign preceded the federal law criminalizing non-consensual AI deepfake imagery.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: New York chatbot kids-safety bill (S.9051/A.10379)
scale: New York State
effect: Passed unanimously: limits chatbots' emotional-bond features for minors, with age assurance and a private right of action.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: ReThink anti-cyberbullying keyboard
scale: About 5M users (per MIT Solve profile)
effect: In studies with 300+ adolescents, willingness to post offensive messages fell from 71% to 4%.
notes: ML flags offensive messages before sending. From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Kid-safe smartphone OS
effect: No social media or open app store; AI filtering of inappropriate texts and images; features expand as the child grows.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: NoSo November detox challenge
scale: 28,000+ students; curriculum in 40+ schools
notes: Youth-led; Young Futures grantee. From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: JED Campus
scale: 440+ campuses in a 4-year mental-health systems program
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Relational Tech Project neighborhood tools
scale: Community Supplies used in 200+ neighborhoods
effect: Tools built so online actions end in in-person contact.
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Hopelab youth mental health research and funding
effect: Research on why youth turn to AI chatbots for emotional support and the risks (dependency, sycophancy, privacy).
notes: From Rhea's Rithm Changemaker Network map; evidence checked 2026-10-20.

name: Open Buildings
scale: Building footprints across Africa, South and Southeast Asia, Latin America
notes: AI-detected footprints released openly (CC BY 4.0).

name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team
scale: 4,000+ datasets on HDX covering 249 countries and territories
notes: Volunteer mapping for disaster response and development.

name: Common Voice
scale: 289 languages, 38,932 hours of speech (Dec 2025)
notes: Crowdsourced, openly released speech data.

name: FLORES+ / Open Language Data Initiative
organization: Open Language Data Initiative (from Meta's FLORES)
scale: 200+ language varieties
notes: Community-maintained evaluation set for translation.

name: Masakhane
notes: Grassroots research community for African-language NLP.

name: Glottolog
notes: Open catalog of the world's languages (CC BY 4.0).

name: Pythia model suite
scale: Models from 70M to 12B parameters with many saved training checkpoints
notes: All models trained on the same data in the same order, so you can study how behaviors form during training. (Details from background knowledge; not re-checked.)

name: OLMo 3
scale: 7B and 32B models
notes: Fully open: weights, training data, code, intermediate checkpoints and training logs (Nov 2025).

name: Gemma Scope 2
scale: Sparse autoencoders and transcoders for every Gemma 3 size (270M–27B)
notes: Ready-made SAEs, CC BY 4.0, so you can study features without training your own.

name: TransformerLens
notes: Library for hooking into and editing small and mid-size models' internals.

name: SAELens and Neuronpedia
notes: Load sparse autoencoders and browse what each feature responds to.

name: nnsight and NDIF (National Deep Inference Fabric)
scale: Hosts very large open models such as Llama 3.1 405B
notes: Run interpretability experiments remotely on models too big for your own machine.

name: Ollama
notes: Runs open models locally for chat and testing; no access to internals. Local use reduces reliance on data centers for everyday queries but not training energy.

name: Novissi emergency cash transfers, targeted by machine learning
organization: Government of Togo; UC Berkeley and Northwestern researchers
scale: Five monthly transfers of about $14 to poor people in rural Togo; millions of dollars paid out
effect: Cut wrongful exclusions by 4 to 21% against the geographic options Togo considered; raised them 9 to 35% against a full household registry, which Togo does not have
notes: People without a phone could not be paid. A later randomized study found phone data less reliable for measuring a programme's impact.

name: HungerMap LIVE
scale: Near real-time food security estimates in 90+ countries at launch; machine-learning estimates for 50 to 64 of them (sources differ)
notes: Where surveys are missing, models estimate food consumption from prices, weather, conflict and other signals. WFP says they explain up to about 70% of the variation.

name: Teaching at the Right Level
scale: Over 60 million students in India and Africa (J-PAL's figure)
effect: Test scores rose 0.07 to 0.70 standard deviations across six randomized evaluations in seven Indian states
notes: Not AI: children are grouped by what they can do, not by grade. Training teachers or handing out materials alone did not work.

name: Women Count gender data programme
scale: 8 programme countries; over $80 million in funding since 2016
effect: Programme countries have 84% of gender-equality goal data available, 23 points above the global figure (2025 annual report)
notes: Not AI: helps national statistics offices collect and publish data by sex.

name: mWater water point monitoring platform
scale: 390,000 users in 199 countries and territories; 1.7 million+ water points mapped (mWater's figures)
notes: Free platform used by governments and NGOs. National monitoring systems in Uganda and Zimbabwe are built on it.

name: Global Electrification Platform
scale: 46 to 58 countries (sources differ)
notes: For each settlement without power, works out whether grid, mini-grid or standalone solar is cheapest. Open data and open-source model (OnSSET).

name: Creating Moves to Opportunity
organization: Opportunity Insights; Seattle and King County housing authorities
scale: 420 families with housing vouchers in Seattle and King County
effect: Share of families moving to high-opportunity neighborhoods rose from about 14% to about 54%
notes: Used the Opportunity Atlas, public data on how children from each census tract fare as adults, to pick neighborhoods; then gave families help with the housing search.

name: Skylight maritime monitoring
scale: More than 300 organizations in about 70 countries (2026 report; Skylight's own site lists 95)
effect: Argentina's Coast Guard used an alert to intercept and fine a vessel fishing illegally
notes: Free to governments and nongovernmental organizations. Flags vessels that appear to be fishing or meeting at sea.

name: GLAD deforestation alerts on Global Forest Watch
organization: World Resources Institute; University of Maryland
scale: 22 tropical countries studied, 2011 to 2018
effect: 18% less deforestation over two years in African forests where organizations subscribed to the alerts; no change found in Asia or South America
notes: Being covered by the alerts was not enough: only places where someone signed up to receive them saw the drop.

name: GiveDirectly cash transfers
scale: Over 125,000 households enrolled in Kenya and Uganda since 2013 (J-PAL's figure, which may be dated)
effect: Monthly spending rose 23% and investment 61% in a randomized trial in western Kenya; no effect found on health or education
notes: Not AI: gives money directly to poor households by mobile phone.

name: Dispensers for Safe Water
scale: Over 4 million people in Kenya, Uganda and Malawi (Evidence Action's figure; its 2025 survey suggests about 40% fewer users in Kenya)
effect: GiveWell estimates water treatment cuts deaths of young children by 14%, and recommended a grant of up to $64.7 million in 2022
notes: Not AI: free chlorine dispensers placed at village water points.

name: Built for Zero
scale: More than 180 communities; $100 million MacArthur award in 2021
effect: Abilene, Texas and Bakersfield/Kern County, California certified as reaching 'functional zero' homelessness for some groups
notes: Communities keep a by-name list of everyone homeless, updated in real time, and work it down. Whether the 2026 goal of 50 communities was met was not found.

name: Climate TRACE emissions tracking
scale: A coalition of over 100 universities, scientists and AI experts; 660 million+ emission sources in its 2024 inventory
notes: Uses satellites and machine learning to estimate where greenhouse gases come from, independent of what countries and companies report.

name: Rainforest Connection acoustic monitoring
scale: 726,000 to 750,000+ hectares protected (its own pages differ)
notes: Solar-powered listening devices in the forest; AI flags chainsaws, gunshots and trucks in real time. Its Arbimon analysis platform is free for researchers.

name: Educate Girls
scale: Rajasthan, India; 768 of 837 out-of-school girls enrolled in the trial area
effect: Learning gains reached 160% of target, about 28% larger than the comparison group, in a three-year randomized trial
notes: Not AI: community volunteers enrol girls who are out of school and tutor children who are behind. Funded through the first development impact bond in education.

name: One Acre Fund
scale: 5.6 to 5.9 million farming households in 10 countries in 2025 (its own reports differ)
effect: Reports farmers earning about 40% more than comparison farmers; an independent randomized trial in Kenya found gains somewhat smaller than its own estimates
notes: Not AI: seed and fertilizer on credit, delivery and training for small farmers.

name: SolarAid and SunnyMoney solar lights
scale: More than 2 million solar lights sold in sub-Saharan Africa, reaching an estimated 10.5 million people (SolarAid's figures)
effect: Families saved an estimated £318 million in fuel costs (SolarAid's estimate)
notes: Not AI: a charity that owns a social enterprise selling solar lights. Income of about £4 million in the year to March 2025.

name: Aid Transparency Index
scale: 50 major aid organizations scored in 2024
effect: Average transparency score rose to 64.4, from 61.8 in 2022
notes: Not AI: scores how openly the world's largest donors publish what they spend.

name: Wikitongues language archive and revitalization fellowship
scale: Resources in 820 languages (October 2024); revitalization projects in 26 to 27 countries since 2021
notes: A crowdsourced archive of video oral histories, plus small grants for people working to keep their own languages alive.

name: Food Rescue Hero
scale: 250 million pounds of food rescued by the end of 2024; partner groups in more than 25 cities
notes: An app that sends volunteer drivers to pick up surplus food and deliver it to people who need it.

name: Global Living Wage Coalition benchmarks
organization: Global Living Wage Coalition; Anker Research Institute
scale: Living wage benchmarks for 40 locations in 23 countries (June 2020)
notes: Not AI: publishes what a worker needs to earn to live decently in a specific place, using one shared method.
